Five functions in `lib/` call `res.send`. I found them with the index lookup plus a grep of `lib/` for every `send` reference, which also covers calls through other variable names.

- `lib/response.js` — `json` (line 279), `jsonp` (line 352) and `sendStatus` (line 376) each end with `return this.send(body)`.
- `lib/response.js` — `render`: its default callback, a closure inside `res.render`, calls `self.send(str)` (line 1044). `self` is just a saved copy of `this`, which is why the index missed it.
- `lib/router/index.js` — `sendOptionsResponse` calls `res.send(body)` (line 655).

The `send(req, ...)` calls at `lib/response.js:447` and `:516` are calls to the `send` package, so they're left out. The other `res.send` matches are only in comments.
